title: Critical Industrial Waste Combustion
gemini_summary: Unpermitted tire and industrial plastic combustion confirmed by 9 citizen visual reports and local ground sensor spike to 248 µg/m³. Severe immediate respiratory hazard for adjacent residential colonies.
recommended_intervention:
1. Dispatch municipal hazardous emissions squad to Block C quadrant.
2. Issue outdoor recess suspension advisory within 2.5km radius.
3. Deploy anti-smog misting cannons along Maa Anandmayee Marg corridor.

action_log.notes: Initial citizen sighting logged with geo-tagged photographic evidence.
Multimodal analysis extracted high-toxicity particulate signature and flagged severe risk.

title: Cross-Border Crop Residue Fire Plume
gemini_summary: Intense stubble combustion cluster generating westward-moving smoke corridor across international border. High particulate density (PM2.5: 192 µg/m³).
recommended_intervention:
1. Alert District Agricultural Magistrate for rapid mechanized fire suppression.
2. Trigger bilateral cross-border clean air coordination bulletin.

action_log.notes: Ground observation reported active crop burning along western perimeter.
Cross-referenced with MODIS thermal hotspot proxy and local anemometer.

action_log.actor: Officer H. Singh (Punjab Pollution Control Board)
action_log.notes: Acknowledged. Dispatched field team with agricultural balers.

title: Freight Transit Heavy Diesel Inversion
gemini_summary: Thermal inversion trapping heavy freight diesel particulates along the Marginal Tietê arterial artery. Ambient PM2.5 elevated to 118 µg/m³.
recommended_intervention:
1. Enforce emergency truck idling restrictions along transit arteries.
2. Reroute non-essential logistics traffic to outer ring roads.

action_log.notes: Traffic smog report submitted via mobile web.
Assessed thermal inversion condition using Open-Meteo boundary layer feed.
Field unit dispatched for vehicular emissions enforcement.

location_name: Marginal Tietê Freight Corridor, São Paulo

title: Coal Mining Coal Dust & SO2 Dispersion
gemini_summary: High wind gusts over open coal stockpiles causing fugitive PM10 and SO2 dispersion across adjacent communities in Mpumalanga. Local concentration peaked at 210 µg/m³.
recommended_intervention:
1. Mandate immediate chemical dust suppressant spraying over active stockpiles.
2. Verify compliance with atmospheric emission license limits.

action_log.notes: Multiple citizen complaints regarding severe coal dust clouds.
Confirmed high particulate loading and fugitive dust trajectory.
Field inspection team dispatched to mining site.
Dust suppressants applied. Stockpile covering verified by inspectors.
